key.name: trigger-width
key.summary: Trigger band width (% of monitor width, centred)

key.name: trigger-height
key.summary: Trigger band height below the work-area top (px)

key.name: show-delay-ms
key.summary: Delay before the layout picker appears (ms)

key.name: restore-size-on-drag
key.summary: Restore a snapped window's previous size when it is dragged out

key.name: snap-assist
key.summary: Offer other windows for the remaining zones after a snap

key.name: disabled-layouts
key.summary: Built-in layout ids hidden from the picker

key.name: match-orientation
key.summary: Offer layouts matching the monitor's orientation
key.description: Landscape monitors show landscape layouts, portrait monitors show portrait layouts; custom layouts without an orientation show on both. When off, every enabled layout is offered everywhere.
